data.name: ALEX RIVERA
data.title: LEARNING & ENABLEMENT LEADER
data.contact: Chicago, IL / Open to remote / alex@example.com
data.summary: Learning and enablement leader with 11 years across healthcare, SaaS, and retail. Builds onboarding, manager development, and the people systems behind them, and measures whether behavior actually changed.

bullets: Built the learning function from zero for a 600-person company, starting with a manager foundations program for every people leader.
Launched the first LMS and connected it to the HRIS so enrollments, completions and org changes stay in sync without manual work.
Cut new-hire ramp time by 25% with a role-based onboarding journey and 30/60/90 check-ins.

roles.title: Senior Instructional Designer
bullets: Designed sales and customer-education programs used by 4,000 customers across three product lines.

roles.title: Instructional Designer
bullets: Produced eLearning, video and job aids for support and success teams.
Delivered store-manager training across 40 locations and rebuilt the new-hire program around on-the-floor practice.

groups.label: Learning & Enablement
groups.text: Learning Strategy / Instructional Design / Manager Development / Onboarding / Facilitation / Measurement

groups.label: Systems
groups.text: LMS Administration / HRIS Integrations / xAPI / Reporting
